name: io.github.SpIob/devlog
description: Offline developer journal with local-LLM digests, semantic search, and MCP server.

environmentVariables.description: Custom data directory for the journal
environmentVariables.name: DEVLOG_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for local date bucketing (e.g., America/New_York)
environmentVariables.name: DEVLOG_TZ

environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for AI features (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)
environmentVariables.name: DEVLOG_OLLAMA_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model for semantic search (default: nomic-embed-text)
environmentVariables.name: DEVLOG_EMBED_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Enable LLM summaries by default (set to '1')
environmentVariables.name: DEVLOG_AI
